content.title: PBC Fight Night - Fundora vs Thurman, Tellez vs Mendoza, Hernandez vs Gausha, & Hovhannisyan vs Navarro
content.text: Fight Night SAT, MAR 28, 2026 8pm ET Eastern Time / 5pm PT Pacific Time MGM Grand Garden Arena, Las Vegas, NV Live On Fundora vs. Thurman FIGHT PREVIEW: March 28, 2026 | PBC PPV on Prime Video 0:31 • Feb 05, 2026 More information on this video WBC Super Welterweight World Champion Sebastian “The Towering Inferno” Fundora will return to the ring looking to continue his 154-pound reign against the former unified world champion Keith “One Time” Thurman in an explosive clash that headlines a PBC Pay-Per-View event on Prime Video on Saturday, March 28 from the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas. Get Fight Alerts Never miss a fight! Add our schedule to your calendar and receive a reminder before this PBC fight. Get Reminders Winner Sebastian Fundora vs Keith Thurman Fundora Defeats Thurman by TKO6 WBC Super Welterweight World Champion Sebastian “The Towering Inferno” Fundora retained his title in style Saturday night with a sixth-round stoppage of former unified champion Keith “One Time” Thurman. Fight Highlights Winner Yoenis Tellez vs Brian Mendoza Tellez Defeats Mendoza by UD Yoenis Tellez (12-1, 8 KOs) scored a hard-fought unanimous decision victory over Brian Mendoza (23-5, 17 KOs) after 10 grueling rounds. Fight Highlights Winner Yoenli Hernandez vs Terrell Gausha Hernandez Defeats Gausha by TKO4 Top-rated middleweight contender Yoenli Hernandez (10-0, 9 KOs) dominated veteran contender and U.S. Olympian Terrell Gausha (24-6-1, 12 KOs) on his way to a fourth-round TKO. Fight Highlights Winner Gurgen Hovhannisyan vs Cesar Navarro Hovhannisyan Defeats Navarro by TKO5 Rising undefeated heavyweight Gurgen “Big Gug” Hovhannisyan (10-0, 8 KOs) delivered a fifth-round stoppage of Cesar Navarro (15-4, 13 KOs) to remain unbeaten. Fight Highlights Winner Elijah Garcia vs Kevin Newman II Newman Defeats Garcia by MD Super middleweight contender Kevin Newman (19-3-1, 11 KOs) edged out a majority decision (98-92, 96-94 and 95-95) over Elijah Garcia (17-2, 13 KOs) after 10 rounds. Fight Highlights Winner Brayan Gonzalez vs Brandon Medina Gonzalez Defeats Medina by TKO5 Unbeaten prospect Brayan Gonzalez (5-0, 4 KOs) scored a fifth-round stoppage (1:57) over Brandon Medina (7-5) in their featherweight matchup. Fight Highlights Winner Kaipo Gallegos vs Julian Gonzalez Gallegos Defeats Gonzalez by UD 20-year-old prospect Kaipo Gallegos (12-0-1, 9 KOs) bounced back from a third-round knockdown to defeat Julian Gonzalez (16-2-1, 12 KOs) in their 10-round lightweight bout. Mar 4, 2026 / Jesus Ramos, Sebastian Fundora vs Keith Thurman, Yoenli Hernandez, Erislandy Lara, Carlos Adames, Janibek Alimkhanuly Yoenli Hernandez: The Return of Middleweight Glory The undefeated Cuban could be the catalyst for bringing the 160-pound division back if he can get past the dangerous Terrell Gausha on the Fundora-Thurman PBC PPV on Prime Video Saturday, March 28.
